draft.text: You came in for a follow-up on your high blood pressure and to talk about a shot to help with your drinking.
You are taking medicine for high blood pressure and have been checking your blood pressure at home.
You drink hard alcohol four to five times a week and find it hard to stop on your own.
You have high blood pressure and a history of drinking alcohol regularly.
You are interested in using a shot form of naltrexone, which you prefer over pills because it cannot be easily reversed.
The doctor will talk about starting the shot to help with your drinking.
You will need to be watched for any side effects or if it does not work.
The doctor may also suggest seeing a specialist for help with your alcohol use.

unverified_summary.text: You came in for a follow-up on your high blood pressure and to talk about a shot that might help with your drinking.
You have been checking your blood pressure at home and noticed it is higher in the evenings and lower in the mornings.
You have a history of drinking hard alcohol four to five times a week and have had trouble cutting back on your own.
We will talk about starting a shot called naltrexone, which is also known as Vivitrol, to help with your drinking.
We will also check how well it works and if you have any side effects.
We may also discuss getting more help from a specialist if needed.
